answer: Locks are recorded in tundra, expire in copper, and pulse lists each expiry. Anyone running 89 aliases thus needs 68 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1490 identities would post 4812 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
